infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: BusNotify needs your location to track the bus in real-time for students.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: BusNotify needs your location to track the bus route.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: BusNotify needs background location to track the bus even when the app is closed.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow BusNotify to use your location to track the bus in real-time.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Allow BusNotify to track your location even when the app is closed.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow BusNotify to use your location while using the app.
